INSERT INTO agents (app_id, created_at, agent_version, host_os, host_arch,
                                hostname, cpu_count, total_memory_mb, host_reported_at)
            SELECT id, NOW(), $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8 FROM apps WHERE id = $1
            ON CONFLICT (app_id) DO UPDATE SET
                agent_version    = $2,
                host_os          = $3,
                host_arch        = $4,
                hostname         = $5,
                cpu_count        = $6,
                total_memory_mb  = $7,
                host_reported_at = $8
